text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — sustained resident growth on paged-attn allocator in inference-pool-7. Multiple nodes flapping, repeated container restarts. Probable slow kv-cache fragmentation causing OOMs.

Ezra: seeing 20% drop in available GPU mem over last 40m on pool-7, evict rate keeps increasing.

Jon: logs show repeated `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` in ml-runtime-3 containers, stack points into paged allocator commit path.

Tara: customer telemetry — a handful of high-traffic customers hit 504s and retries spiked. CS pinged for potential ops impact.

Maria: confirmed model routing shows traffic pinned to pool-7 for redwood/gpt-rl-13b; I'll start rerouting to pool-3 canary.

Ezra: immediate mitigation plan:
- cordon affected nodes (no new containers)
- trigger kv-page compaction on resident slab
- enable early-kv-evict hotflag to drop low-use pages
- reduce batch size on active routes

infra-bot: cordon executed on node-7-2, node-7-3. (action by infra-bot) :white_check_mark:

Jon: running compaction now. command: 
```
# compaction trigger (unsafe, live)
curl -X POST http://node-7-3:15000/debug/kv/compact -d '{"force":true}'
```

Jon: compaction logs showing ~700MB freed on node-7-3, but node-7-4 still drifting.

Tara: CustomerOps — customers A and B saw 2-3% error rate increase on the last 15m, nothing yet escalated but CS notified.

CustomerOps: we opened tickets with both customers, letting them know we're working mitigation and will share ETA.

Maria: started traffic drain from pool-7 to pool-3 for the affected model. Observing latency normalization on pool-3.

Ezra: discovered allocator histo: lots of small page survivors ~64–256B creating fragmentation. Hypothesis: a regression in kv retention threshold (recent change to prefetched-kv TTL).

Jon: stack snippet from crash: 
```
malloc_pages(ctx) -> commit_pages -> cudaMalloc -> OOM
# callers: paged_attn::commit_kv, runtime::allocate_prefetch
```

Ezra: temporary hotfix applied: reverted prefetched-kv TTL to 30s (previously 5m). Patch id: rwd-hotfix/2024-174321.

infra-bot: restarted ml-runtime-3 containers on node-7-4 (rolling).

Tara: early numbers: error rate down to 0.4% for affected customers after reroute + compaction. Keeping on watch.

Maria: adding routing fallback for model variants to avoid >1x memory variants on pool-7. Will document change in rollout dashboard.

Ezra: follow-up actions (for postmortem):
- revert/guard the prefetched-kv TTL change in feature flagging
- add continuous compaction when fragmentation >50%
- instrument per-page-age metrics in KV cache
- add an auto-evict policy for small-page survivors

Jon: saved heap dumps from node-7-3 and node-7-4 to s3://rwd-ops/oom-dumps/1743219876/ for deeper analysis.

CustomerOps: customers A/B acknowledged, will wait for postmortem. No escalations.

Ezra: handing off to Jon (night oncall) in 30m — keep routing off pool-7 until we've validated sustained drop for 2 hours.

Jon: ack. I'll continue watch and start a focused grep for any recent commits touching kv retention/evict logic.

Maria: creating incident ticket INC-174321 in tracker with timeline + mitigation steps.

Ezra: if drift resumes, escalate to infra for node repro (kernel + cuda driver check). For now leaning to allocator logic.

Jon: note — we should add a synthetic test that forces small-page survivor pattern against paged-attn to catch regressions in CI.

Ezra: thanks team. leaving notes in runbook and will author an initial postmortem draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
